email.body1:
Roy, saw iPipeline launched its AI-first platform for life, annuities, and wealth and landed on the 2026 WealthTech100.

A new platform means reps have to ramp on a new story fast, while more in-market accounts surface than the team can reach. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount and reps spend time in conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for iPipeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Roy, quick follow-up for iPipeline.

From an enablement seat, the cost of a launch is rep time: hours on research and writing instead of selling the new story, which slows ramp and leaves pipeline on the table.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the North American team needs this quarter, and how taking research and writing off reps speeds it up.
email.body3:
Roy, last bit of proof for iPipeline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how iPipeline's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Roy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding ramp and freeing rep time isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Enabling a team on a new platform is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sales enablement motion? I'll tailor it to iPipeline either way.
